messages:
Ivy Park: Heads-up 50-day recurrence sweep completed for AprJun. Pulled cross-postmortem signatures + alert windows. Found 4 repeating failure clusters and a handful of infra-induced blips. High-level: cache eviction hotspots (multi-tenant), fallback thrash during capacity dips, scheduler preempt races, and intermittent egress throttles.

Noah Kim: can you share counts or a short table so we can prioritize?

Ivy Park: sure, clipped results from the scan: 

```
signature | incidents
CACHE_EVICT_THRASH | 26
FALLBACK_THRASH | 18
SCHEDULER_PREEMPT_RACE | 11
EGRESS_THROTTLE_BURST | 7
others | 12
```

Rhea Singh: i'll take CACHE_EVICT_THRASH. plan: isolate heavy tenants, add per-tenant eviction caps, and surface eviction latency in dashboards. ETA 3 weeks. i'll add rollback flag.

Noah Kim: i'll own FALLBACK_THRASH. fix: add rollout cooldowns, add per-pool fallback hysteresis, and gating in console to pause rollouts if fallback rate > 4% for 5m. ETA 2 wks.

Ivy Park: nice. I'll create epic INC-4599 "Recurrence sweep Apr-Jun: mitigation" and seed tickets. ops-bot, create epic and tag triage-weekly.

ops-bot: Created epic INC-4599: "Recurrence sweep Apr-Jun: mitigation" labels: recurrence, triage-weekly. https://jira.local/browse/INC-4599

Rhea Singh: action items for INC-4599 (will add to epic):
- Rhea Singh 50 tenant isolation + eviction caps + dashboard metrics  due 2026-06-18
- Noah Kim  rollout cooldown + fallback hysteresis + canary gating  due 2026-06-11
- Platform SRE  egress retry/backoff and infra alert tuning  due 2026-06-08
- Scheduler team (No owner assigned)  preempt race probe + lock mitigation  due 2026-06-20

Noah Kim: noted re: scheduler. i'll sync with scheduler leads and assign owner by EOD. also adding a short load test to the PRs to check p95 impact.

Ivy Park: meeting: let's have a 30m triage next Tue 2026-05-12 17:00 UTC to reconfirm owners and blockers. Ping here if anything blocks earlier. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Triage: INC-4599 owners sync" on 2026-05-12 17:00 UTC.
